Penguins are sanctuary and pet animals. They are unlocked at reputation level 3.

Like all other sanctuary animals, players can only have four of them, one of each type.

Appearance

Penguins have two different appearances: blue and grey.

Blue
Blue chick
Grey
Grey chick

Unlocking penguins

Unlike other animals, penguins cannot be bought. Players must unlock them by finding puzzle pieces (which are collected in a log book). 36 pieces are required for each animal.

Once players have obtained a first penguin, the puzzle for the second penguin is unlocked. After both adult penguins have been added to the sanctuary, the puzzle for one of the chicks is unlocked.

Placing penguins

Players must have a penguin house to be able to place the animal in the sanctuary. The penguin house is free and can be obtained from the Shop Shop.

When a second penguin is added to the sanctuary, an upgraded penguin house is obtained from the Shop. Upgrading does not cost anything. When the house is big enough to welcome a new animal, it is delivered in a crate, "airlifted" into the sanctuary by balloons.

Feeding penguin

Penguins are fed with meat buckets. Once penguins have eaten eat they roam the sanctuary for ten hours and finally fall asleep. Players can immediately wake them up to receive 25 xp per animal and a chance to get supplies. Penguins stay asleep otherwise.

Penguins which have been woken up but are not fed for a long while cannot fall asleep and wander around looking sleepy and tired.

  • Tip: Waking up sanctuary animals one by one instead of using a whistle may increase your chance of getting supplies.

Decorations

Each penguint unlocks some decorations in the shop as specified below:

Sand Plant (Blue)
Rocky Shore (Blue chick)
Floated Wood (Grey)
Shore Flowers (Grey chick)

With each animal players are given the first pair of decorations for free.
